description: The basic-call cases (identity + real-RTP media with classifier replay) driven through the ALREADY-RUNNING kind cluster: alice and bob1 on the host's external-bridge address (192.168.60.1), calls ingressing the sip-front-proxy external VIP (192.168.60.250), routed by the host to the proxy nodes that announce it, the b-leg pinned to bob1 via X-Api-Call.destination and still riding LB-first per the production invariant.
